test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A, B and C together can finish a piece of work in 20 days. A alone can finish the work in 40 days. What part of the work B and C together can finish in a day?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total work = LCM(20, 40) = 40 units.

Combined efficiency of A, B, and C = 40 ÷ 20 = 2 units/day.

Efficiency of A alone = 40 ÷ 40 = 1 unit/day.

Efficiency of B and C together = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/day.

Part of the work completed by B and C in 1 day = 1 / 40.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A, B, and C together to finish the work = 20 days

Time taken by A alone to finish the work = 40 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of given days

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A + B + C
 20

 40 ÷ 20 = 2
 
 

 A
 40
 40 ÷ 40 = 1
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of (B + C) = Efficiency of (A + B + C) − Efficiency of A

⇒ Efficiency of (B + C) = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Part of the work B and C together finish in a day = Efficiency of (B + C) ÷ Total Work

⇒ Part of work = 1 ÷ 40 = 1/40

**∴ The correct answer is 1/40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Time & Work Relation

Total Work = Efficiency × Time taken. Time taken and efficiency are inversely proportional to each other for a given amount of work.

Pipes & Cisterns

Works on the same concept as Time & Work, but filling pipes have positive efficiency while emptying pipes have negative efficiency.

Work & Wages

Total wages are always distributed in the ratio of the actual total work done by the individuals, not just their efficiency or time.
